name: start_flag_build

name: start_end_build
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B8, issue #16). 0x7FE920 (start end) = B_st && (0x7FD058 & 1); 0x7FD05B counts cycles since then; B_stend 0x7FE921 = 0x7FD05B > 3. re/findings/start.md section 4.

name: mixture_running_build
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B8, issue #16). Builds 0x803020 (Q12, 4096 = 1.0), the mixture factor gk_rk uses once the start has ended: 0x80301C from the sub-factors 0x7FD261/0x7FD263/0x7FD265/0x7FD266/0x7FD267 and 0x801CF7..0x801D06; 0x803022 = 0x80301C + 0x1000; 0x803020 = mul_q15(0x803026, (0x7FD264 * 0x803022) >> 7), stored at 0x41A250. Insertion point S2 of re/findings/start.md section 4.2.

name: esstt_ksta
notes: VERIFIED-DYNAMIC (B8, issue #16). %ESSTT low-pressure start quantity. Early-out: if B_stend (0x7FE921) then ksta_adapted (0x80302C) = 0x400 = 1.0. Otherwise anztist(0x7FD269) = clamp(0x7FD298-0x7FD26B); 0x80302A = KFWKSTT(0x5C6C60; tmst,anztist) * KFKSTT(0x5C6E24; tmst,prist) >> 7; * KFWKSTN(0x5C6C46; tmst,nmot8) >> 8; * 0x7FD067 (Q7); * map 0x5D3739(tmst,0x800EEC) -> ksta 0x803028; 0x80302C = kstaa(0x7FD27B) * max(ksta,0x400) >> 7. u16 with 1024 = 1.0. Model + emulator check: emu/start_model.py, tests/test_start_model.py. re/findings/start.md section 3.

name: esstt_ksta_hdr
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B8, issue #16). High-pressure-start twin of esstt_ksta: same structure on KFKSTTHDR (0x5C6E66) and KFWKSTTHDR (0x5C6D40); shares KFWKSTN (0x5C6C50) and the 0x5D3745 weighting. Publishes the same 0x80302C at 0x41A808. Runs only while B_stend (0x7FE921) is clear. re/findings/start.md section 3.

name: gk_rk
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC. Gemischkontrolle: base fuel mass * fr (0x802DF8 / 0x802E00, Q15) + fra (0x801D1A) * frm (0x801E36 / 0x801E28, Q15), minus 0x80315C, then the ZGST per-cylinder factor 0x801D8C[cyl]; publishes rk at RAM 0x803038 with the sth at 0x41ADD4. B6 #14, re/findings/injection.md section 9

name: stadap_kstaa
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B8, issue #16). %STADAP start-quantity adaptation. Maintains the adaptation bytes 0x7FD278/0x7FD279/0x7FD27A behind the state word 0x801D2E and publishes kstaa = 0x7FD27B at 0x41B6B0 (u8, 128 = 1.0), which esstt_ksta multiplies ksta by. re/findings/start.md section 3.2.

name: awea_ti_to_angle
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC. Converts ti into a crank angle dwi = (ti * k_nmot[0x803072]) >> 13 (result 0x803088) and clamps the start/end-of-injection angles - this, not a ti maximum, is the injection window limit. Window scalars 0x5D396D / 0x5D396E (both 0x00 in this dataset), runtime terms 0x7FD28E / 0x7FD290. The FR's %AWEA. B6 #14, re/findings/injection.md section 8

name: rksplit
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC. Splits rk (RAM 0x803038) over the active injections into 0x8030B4/B6 (type 0x2000), 0x8030BA/BC (type 0x400), 0x8030B8 (homogeneous) and 0x8030BE (start), under the type bits of RAM 0x803092; the split fractions are the bytes 0x801D89 / 0x801D8A. The FR's %RKSPLIT. B6 #14, re/findings/injection.md section 6.1

name: aes_ti_out
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC. Calls rk2ti for every active injection, writes the per-injection ti to 0x8030E4/E6/E8/EA and the total to 0x8030C4 (the VCDS group 002.3 value), and raises the 'ti is at TIMINP' flag 0x7FEA54/0x7FEA55. The FR's %AES. B6 #14, re/findings/injection.md sections 2 and 3

name: aes_ti_out_start
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC. The start-injection counterpart of aes_ti_out, called from the second engine-synchronous task 0x4224BC. B6 #14, re/findings/injection.md

name: zw_output_driver
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). FUN_004741f0((short)(0x7FD32E[cyl] * 0xF >> 1), dwell 0x802080, cyl). The *15/2 converts the 0.75 deg/LSB ignition angle into 0.1 deg units - the independent proof of the fixed-point format.

name: zwbas_per_bank
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). Critical section; two banks (i=1 then 0). zwgru + bank offset (0x7FD318/0x7FD319) + 0x7FD338 + 0x7FD31A + 0x80208E, then + 0x7FD347 + knock retard dwkrz[0x7FCE57][cyl] + the s8 calibration offset 0x5C753A. Writes 0x7FD30C (bank 1) and 0x7FD30B (bank 0); 0x7FD30A = copy of bank 0 for the torque model. re/findings/ignition.md section 4.

name: zwgru_dzw_kg
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). Delta map 0x5C753E (16x12 s8) on the KFZW axis keys, weighted by ((0x800EC0>>1)-(0x800020>>1)) in 1.15 fixed point and clamped above by the s8 scalar 0x5C753D. re/findings/ignition.md section 3.

name: zwgru_kfzw_lookup
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). %ZWGRU base map lookup: axis_search_u16_hint(0x5C7736=nmot block, nmot_w@0x7FEE74, hint@0x7FD5EC), same for the rl block 0x5C7758 with rl_w@0x7FEFB2 and hint@0x7FD5F0, then interp_2d_s8(KFZW=0x5C75FE, nx=12). Returns KFZW in s8, 0.75 deg CA per LSB. See re/findings/ignition.md section 2.

name: zwgru_build
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). zwgru = KFZW + dzw_kg + (0x800006-0x800007 when 0x5C753C bit7 clear) + 0x800004 + 0x7FD313 + 0x7FD337, saturated to s8, stored to zwgru@0x7FD315. THE INSERTION POINT for an additive ethanol ignition offset is the word at 0x41D40C (add r3,r3,r10), before the clamp at 0x41D410: knock retard and every limit still act on top. re/findings/ignition.md section 11.

name: zwmin_select
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). zwmin@0x7FD32A = 0x7FD32B, or 0x7FD32C when 0x7FD306 & 0x40. Entry point of the ZWSEL/ZWOUT block at 0x41D464.

name: zwout_select
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). %ZWSEL/%ZWOUT: per bank picks between the bank angle 0x7FD30B[i], zwmin 0x7FD32A and 0x7FCEED, adds 0x7FD317 for the second bank, clamps to -0x48..+0x4E (-54..+58.5 deg) and stores 0x7FD32E[bank]. Exports 0x7FEF85 and the tester bytes 0x7FEF87/0x7FEF88 (measuring var id 9 = VCDS group 003 field 4) with inverted copies 0x7FD334/0x7FD335.

name: task_segment_a
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC. Engine- (segment-) synchronous ERCOSEK task, TCB entry 5, id 40, priority 0x0A (B1, re/findings/scheduler.md section 4). Flat list of 60 argument-less bl; the fuelling run is 0x422478 gk -> 0x42247C rksplit -> 0x422480 aes_ti_out -> 0x422484 awea. The bl at 0x42247C is B6's flex-fuel hook site. B6 #14, re/findings/injection.md section 6.2

name: task_segment_b
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC. The second engine-synchronous ERCOSEK task, TCB entry 6 at 0x47870C, id 41, priority 0x0A, flag 0x7FE642 (re/findings/scheduler.md section 4). Alias task41_ignition (B7, issue #15): 42 straight-line bl's covering the whole ignition module chain, incl. zwopt_build (0x4224DC), zwgru_build (0x4224E0), zwbas_per_bank (0x4224F4), zwmin_select/zwout_select (0x422500, 0x422560) and the output scheduler 0x41CC0C (0x422568); also the only caller of aes_ti_out_start (B6, issue #14, re/findings/injection.md). Period not established; segment-synchronous is a HYPOTHESIS. Two rows merged into one at integration 2026-09-15; ghidra_scripts/b7_ignition_symbols.csv still applies the alias name.

name: can_rx_eval_bremse

name: rkti_pre_start

name: zwgru_10ms_driver
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B8, issue #16). 10 ms driver of the base ignition: sets 0x7FEA72 = (nmot8 < 0x5C76BE), recomputes zwgru_kfzw/zwgru_dzw here when the speed is above that threshold, and computes 0x7FD313 = KF(0x5C76D5; nmot8, efficiency 0x7FD271) -- the warm-up/torque-reserve ignition term that zwgru_build adds. re/findings/start.md section 5.1.

name: zwstt_build
notes: VERIFIED-DYNAMIC (B8, issue #16). Start ignition angle -> zwstt 0x802096 (s8, 0.75 deg CA per LSB), stb at 0x431384. Runs only while 0x7FECCA (= B_stend) is clear. KFZWSTT(0x5C7B64; zdgz 0x7FCE14, tmst) + KFZWSTN(0x5C7B23; nmot8, tmst), or the 0x5C7B40 map when 0x7FCE0C bit 1 is set, plus the 1D s8 term 0x5C7BAB over 0x7FD3E5. INSERTION POINT Z1 for a start-ignition ethanol offset. re/findings/start.md section 5.

name: tmot_task

CORRECTED 2026-09-16 (C4, issue #44, scheduler.md 11): period SETTLED: **10 ms**, not 100 ms - this is the acceptance criterion of #44. Task id 19, handle 0x4787A4; activated by os_raster_select (0x443F74) when the task-set byte 0x7FAB55 is 0, which is what os_init writes at 0x11B148, on alarm 1's 35087-tick cycle. Its bl at 0x432BBC runs os_raster_divider_a. VERIFIED-DYNAMIC as well (emu/os_clock.py).

name: zwopt_delta_maps
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B7, issue #15). Reads the two 16x11 s8 KFZWOP delta maps 0x5C9E25 (axis block 0x5C9E08) and 0x5C9EF2 (axis block 0x5C9ED5); both all zeros in this dataset. Also a 1-D curve at 0x5C9FA2.

name: zw_eta_offset
notes: VERIFIED-STATIC (B8, issue #16). Converts the torque coordinator's efficiency demand 0x803042 (u16, 4096 = 1.0) into the additive ignition angle 0x800004 (s8); exactly 0 when the demand is 1.0. Second half of the warm-up / catalyst-heating retard path. re/findings/start.md section 5.1.

name: kfzwop_lookup
